name: 30125 · Cedartown, GA
findings: ZIP 30125 (Cedartown) has 40 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30125 (Cedartown) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 30125 (Cedartown) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 44% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.
